mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, we are seeing 60 degree temperatures with fog lingering near Reddan Soccer Park, and the moon is currently in its third quarter phase.

City residents should know that the Verona Senior Center offers a free tri-shaw bike program for seniors to enjoy the Military Ridge State Trail, while the Parks Department is currently seeking applicants for seasonal positions like lifeguards.
There is plenty to do in town, with Yoga at Insight Wellness and the Concerts in the Park series both taking place today, plus trivia at Hop Haus occurring today as well.
In our weekly report, on July 31st, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in the driver being arrested for O W I and cited for suspended vehicle registration.
Today is the perfect day for a Chocolate Caramel Twist, but keep in mind that the store is currently closed and will open its doors at 10 AM.
